issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for addGuestStudents: the problem statement (task description and UML) declares addGuestStudents(int): void, and the solution implementation defines public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). The template repository instead declares a two-parameter method public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) which differs in parameter count and will confuse students and automated tests about the required signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template signature match the problem statement and solution by changing the template method to: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) { ... }. If input validation is desired, implement it inside that single-parameter method or add a private/helper overload; alternatively, if the boolean parameter is intentional, update the problem statement UML and the solution to document and implement the two-parameter signature consistently.
